title: Skills
selectSessionHint: Select a thread first to view skill configuration

loadErrors.title: Failed to load ({{n}})
loadErrors.hint: These skills exist in .rivet/skills/ but could not be parsed (usually missing/malformed frontmatter). Fix them and reopen a thread to take effect:

install.notice: Copied to .rivet/skills/. A new thread is required to take effect — hot-loading skills mid-session shatters the prefix cache and can cost dozens of times more.

pending.title: Pending (reopen thread)
pending.desc: Installed — available after opening a new thread

empty.hint: Put skills into .rivet/skills/ or enable importFromClaude in config

cap.overLimit: — limit reached; avoid installing more unless necessary (click twice to confirm)

restraint: Installing skills blindly is not recommended. Tianshu natively integrates the development workflow, covering about 90% of real-world tasks — use native capabilities first and install only when truly needed. This entire project uses no more than 5 installed skills, and 70% of its own code was built that way; skipping skills does not hinder real task completion.

detail.loadedEffect: Toggling takes effect immediately in the current session
detail.installableEffect: Takes effect only in a new thread after install (protects the prefix cache; no mid-session hot loading)
